question: Propose the most cost-effective measurable leading indicator (predictor) for the stated failure, its operating threshold, and the concrete test that would validate or kill the predictor.
pipeline_answer:
Monitoring the degradation of heat transfer efficiency in water-cooled condenser tubes caused by fouling resistance accumulation.

Compute a real-time fouling index by analyzing the deviation of the condenser water supply and return temperature differential against the outdoor wet-bulb baseline, utilizing BMS-logged points to trigger a cleaning protocol within 3 days of exceeding a deviation threshold.

Reduces total compressor energy by at least 3 percent versus the fixed monthly cadence by eliminating unnecessary labor and cleaning early when thermal efficiency drops.

Simulate a 5% increase in fouling resistance; verify that the BMS-based predictor alerts within the 3-day window and that energy consumption calculations confirm a >3% savings compared to the fixed monthly baseline.

The condenser tube bank operates with optimized thermal efficiency, maintaining compressor power within baseline tolerances while shifting from time-based to condition-based maintenance.
